comparison.reading: supervised error ≈ ridge error: compact dimensionality plausible; ridge error ≪ supervised error: linear but not ≤ 4-dimensional; both poor: linear generalization from E(w) questionable

selection.rule: eligible = {1} ∪ {r > 1 : error_r ≤ 0.8 × error_1}; r_best = argmin_{eligible} error_r; threshold = error_{r_best} + SE_{r_best}; selected = min {r ∈ eligible : error_r ≤ threshold}
